posts.title: Composing product lists with ServiceComposer
posts.description: A product identifier lets services work independently. A product list first needs someone to select the products. How composition events provide that context without a central controller knowing every service.

posts.title: One product page, three services
posts.description: Catalog owns the name, Finance owns the price, and Marketing owns the rating. How does OmNomNom turn those separate contributions into one product page?

posts.title: Is AI another dot-com bubble, about to burst?
posts.description: AI may be in a bubble, but Jevons' paradox suggests cheaper intelligence will make usage and infrastructure demand explode anyway.
